source.title: Submerged Arc Welding Open Repository
source.version: v2 (record landing page; absent in API metadata)
source.changes: Selected actual PP3–PP7 workbook rows transcribed to JSON with original cached values; original numeric codes/nulls retained. Added source locators, inferred design-code correspondence and conservative issue annotations. No correction or invented measurement. This is not the existing synthetic fixture dataset.

scope: 243 actual annotation rows, consumed development; not 243 physical defects or held-out benchmark
provenance_rule: For each annotation, original header cells are A1:G1 in coupon sheet; each value cell is column_cells[field] concatenated with excel_row. Observation source cell_range includes all seven original cells. Defect dictionary uses A2:B7; setting dictionary codes use A3:A13 and values B3:H13 with field headers B2:H2.

design.qualification: Manual explicit mapping of design bead ranges to matching workbook nominal tuples; not measured process settings
design.PP4_status: Download truncated (212608/239292 compressed bytes); rejected, no retry. Same design size/CRC in inventory only, not SHA-verified. PP4 comparison to shared PP3 design remains provisional.

rows.design_provenance: ZENODO_Penelope/PP4/Design_Materials_Settings.pdf page 2 Settings parameters; provisional shared-PP3-design comparison because PP4 transfer failed

caveats: Annotation rows have no physical-defect identifier; repeated location across beads is not independent physical defects.
All workbook dictionary joins resolve; bead links are naming-convention links to central-directory process files, not verified HDF5 measurements.
Cross-modality defect identity and signal sample alignment unverified.
Descending start/end is a candidate consistency issue under an explicit ascending-interval contract, not confirmed source error or authority to swap values.
No official weld repair/release decision policy established by the audited files.
PP4–PP7 RX/UT reports not acquired or inspected in this audit.
Whole-archive hash not verified; preserved bytes CRC and SHA checked individually.
Differences between coupons are descriptive and do not establish causal setting effects.
Shared-design mismatch does not establish that the worksheet is wrong; deviation or stale design remains possible.
No personnel, signatures, report images, or workbook author metadata included. Scholarly authors are retained solely for required source attribution.

verification.scope: local deterministic source audit, not benchmark
